title: Observe sequence number handling
close_reason: Already fixed: _should_accept() in python/src/lichen/client/ip_coap.py correctly implements RFC 7641 Section 4.4 observe sequence number handling using 24-bit modular arithmetic (diff = (seq - last_seq) & 0xFFFFFF; accept if 0 < diff < 0x800000). Test vectors exist in test/vectors/coap_observe_sequence.json. Note: one vector (observe_seq_large_jump_accept) has an off-by-one error (new_seq=8389608 gives diff=8388608 exactly at boundary, should be 8389607 for 'just under half').
